SELECT 
  category,
  AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining,
  SUM(amount - spent) as total,
  SUM(amount - spent) - (SELECT AVG(total_diff) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount - spent) as total_diff FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category)) as above_average
FROM budget
WHERE amount > 75
GROUP BY category
HAVING SUM(amount - spent) > (SELECT AVG(total_diff) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount - spent) as total_diff FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category))
